title: Minimal Equiangular Hyperbolic Polyhedra in the Tetrahedral Range
summary: We study the minimum-volume problem for finite-volume convex hyperbolic polyhedra whose dihedral angles are all equal to a fixed number \(α\). In the non-obtuse case one necessarily has \[ \fracπ{3}\le α\le \fracπ{2}. \] We prove that throughout the full range in which the regular hyperbolic tetrahedron with dihedral angle \(α\) exists, \[ \fracπ{3}\le α<\arccos\frac13, \] it is the unique minimum-volume equiangular hyperbolic polyhedron with prescribed angle \(α\).
